project_type: Next.js 15.5.2 App Router with static export, Tailwind CSS, Supabase Auth, Cloudflare Pages Functions
build_system: pnpm 10.28.1 with next build (static export to out/). Node.js requires mise activation: eval "$(mise env)"
test_framework: Vitest with tests in tests/ directory (tests/engine/, tests/lib/)
build_command: eval "$(mise env)" && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && pnpm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise env)" && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && pnpm run test -- --run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: pnpm run typecheck. 2. Run tests: pnpm run test -- --run. 3. Run build: pnpm run build. All must pass with zero errors.
setup_instructions: eval "$(mise env)" && cd /projects/sandbox/ClassAid && corepack enable (node 22 + pnpm 10.28.1 already installed via mise)
environment_constraints: Node.js 22 installed via mise; must run eval "$(mise env)" before any node/pnpm commands. OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access available.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS for styling, Zod for validation, cross-domain (no hardcoded discipline logic), demo mode must work without Supabase, secrets never exposed to client, scoring is server-side only.
key_patterns: Demo mode uses demoUsers array from seed.ts with role switcher in navigation. AppProvider in providers.tsx manages all state via React Context + localStorage persistence. MainRouter routes by role. Each role view is a top-level component (LearnerDashboard, InstructorDashboard, AdminRegistry). Instructor has sub-navigation tabs (insights/configure/checkpoints/content). The demo role switcher picks the first user from demoUsers matching the selected role. DemoUser type: { id, name, role, email }.
directory_structure: src/app/ (page entry), src/components/ (learner/, instructor/, admin/, auth/, shared UI), src/lib/ (domain/types, engine/, data/seed, api-client, persistence), functions/api/ (Cloudflare Pages Functions), tests/ (engine/, lib/), migrations/ (Supabase schema)
